---
name: register-document-version
description: Register draft, revised, adopted, executed, and superseded versions of a planning document as separate records with explicit relationships.
---

# Register a document version

1. Create a distinct source record for every file, even when filenames or titles
   are nearly identical.
2. Record document ID, visible title, issuing body, publication date, first-seen
   meeting, signature status, and hash.
3. Assign a stable logical family such as `UM_2025-0004_resolution`.
4. Record version labels such as `initial_draft`, `revised_draft`,
   `adopted_unsigned`, `executed`, or `superseded`.
5. Record `supersedes`, `superseded_by`, or `derived_from` only when supported
   by the document or proceeding.
6. Never use upload time alone to infer legal effect.
7. Keep conflicting 19-, 20-, and 21-condition versions simultaneously.

The result must answer: which file, which version, available when, considered
at which meeting, adopted by what action, and later replaced by what.
